description: Places de stationnement pour personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) sur la commune d'Anglet is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. L'accessibilité de la voirie aux personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) est l'une des priorités des collectivités territoriales. Elle nécessite de nombreux aménagements techniques et travaux d'accessibilité comme par exemple le stationnement PMR. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public, Economie et Social. Its keywords are Places de stationnement, PMR, Handicap, Anglet, Données ouvertes. The portal shows 233 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
